note: The census area is an unorganized borough with no county zoning. Its incorporated cities publish zoning only as PDF maps and code: Craig publishes zoning maps as PDFs, and Thorne Bay publishes a zoning map PDF plus Title 17 code. No queryable zoning district polygon service was found in ArcGIS Hub/Online or on the city sites. Klawock and Hydaburg were not found publishing one either. The state does not zone private lands.
